stop_a.index: Both are i/lf w/crlf, with CRLF stored pins matching working bytes, not LF index bytes.
why_blocked: Required -text disables checkout conversion: git checkout would restore the LF index bytes.
Retaining current CRLF working bytes under -text instead makes their raw content differ from the index.
Adding those CRLF blobs would change index content, forbidden by rule (a).
Four current API runtime receipts have the same CRLF-pin/LF-index conflict; see the table.
stop_a.action: No .gitattributes edit, no re-checkout, no index normalization, no pin or receipt rewrite.
